messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PROD - elevated 5xx on /v1/generate, urgency=P1. Paging Maya Singh (oncall). See alert: https://ops.redwood/internal/alert/2345 :rotating_light:
Maya Singh: on it. looking at metrics now. any customer impact notes?
Kevin Zhao: seeing a spike in upstream 504s from egress pool us-west-2-e1. latencies jump ~2000ms starting ~14:03 UTC.
Lia Ortiz: confirming, dashboards show error budget burn and request spike on gateway. Count of 5xx by upstream: egress-a: 60%, egress-b: 30%, others 10%.
Maya Singh: copy. hypothesis 1 = client SDK auto-retry causing amplification, hypothesis 2 = upstream regression returning 5xx, hypothesis 3 = ingress proxy backpressure.
Tom Winder: customer reports a few failed calls, but not all. Trying to fetch raw ingress logs for a sample correlation id.
Maya Singh: Kevin — can you grab a few trace IDs from the 14:03 window? we need an example showing retry loops.
Kevin Zhao: grabbing. grep output for status=502 cid=cid:ZX7kH:```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z ingress gw-01 request_id=cid:ZX7kH path=/v1/generate status=502 attempt=1 upstream=egress-a trace=trc-001
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z ingress gw-01 request_id=cid:ZX7kH path=/v1/generate status=502 attempt=2 upstream=egress-a trace=trc-002
2026-03-15T14:03:13Z ingress gw-01 request_id=cid:ZX7kH path=/v1/generate status=200 attempt=3 upstream=egress-b trace=trc-003
```
Lia Ortiz: that looks like a retry loop: ingress retries same req across upstreams. attempt field increments. SDK might be retrying on client side and server is also retrying.
Maya Singh: good find. timeline so far: 14:03:10 - traffic surge to /v1/generate; 14:03:12 - first 502s from egress-a; 14:03:14 - gateway attempts fanout across upstreams causing transient 5xx counts to spike.
SRE Oncall: suggest quick mitigation: 1) temporarily disable proxy-level retries for /v1/generate 2) throttle bursty IPs via rate limit 3) set fallback to smaller model for latency-sensitive routes. Which is fastest?
Tom Winder: disabling proxy retries is quick, one flag flip on ingress config and roll to all regions. Can do in ~4m.
Kevin Zhao: if SDK is retrying, we also need to reach out to client teams to disable aggressive client retries. but server-side change will reduce amplification immediately.
Maya Singh: do the config flip. Tom, take action and paste rollout id. I'll coordinate comms and customer impact note.
Tom Winder: toggling ingress-retry=false for route /v1/generate in staging -> canary -> prod. kicking rollout: deploy/rollout/4452.
incident-bot: Deploy started: deploy/rollout/4452 (Tom Winder). CI checks running.
Lia Ortiz: watching error rate graph. small dip already after canary completed in us-west-2.
Kevin Zhao: logs show fewer repeat attempts per request after canary. example cid:ZX7kH now shows single attempt status=200.
Maya Singh: excellent. moving to mitigation confirmation phase. Lia, collect 5xx counts pre/post for the last 10m and drop in channel.
Lia Ortiz: pre (14:00-14:10): 5xx=1200, post-mitigation (14:12-14:22): 5xx=210. attaching quick snippet (pasted).
Maya Singh: drafting customer impact note: affected subset of telemetry-backed SDKs (client-sdk >=3.2.1) that do aggressive retries. impact window ~14:03-14:12 UTC. partial failures, some retries resulted in delayed success.
Kevin Zhao: next steps: 1) follow up with SDK team to release patch to backoff/retry policy 2) adjust ingress default to not double-retry by default 3) post-incident RCA and timeline.
Tom Winder: rollback plan ready if disabling retries causes regressions: revert flag and re-enable 1) revert deploy/rollout/4452.
Maya Singh: creating RCA thread after this. tagging owners: @kevin, @lia, @tom, @sdk-team. Thanks all — looks mitigated. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: leaving note: will monitor 1h, paging reopened if rate > baseline*2.
Maya Singh: final note for in-thread hypothesis tracking: Hypothesis A (amplification via SDK+proxy retries) = confirmed; Hypothesis B (upstream regression) = inconclusive but secondary contributor; Hypothesis C (ingress backpressure) = minor. We'll include trace samples and KV log extracts in RCA.
Tom Winder: attaching KV log snippet for postmortem (saved to gs://redwood-ops/incidents/2112345678/kvlogs.txt).
Maya Singh: thanks team. closing the pager but leaving channel open for RCA compilation.
